title: Resolution urging Congress to let SNAP buy hot foods
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass, and the President to sign, the federal Hot Foods Act of 2025, which would let SNAP benefits be used to buy hot foods or ready-to-eat hot food products. Current federal law excludes hot foods from SNAP-eligible purchases, which advocates say creates barriers for people who lack time, cooking equipment or storage to prepare meals. As of June 2025 about 1.8 million New Yorkers, roughly 20 percent of the city's population, received SNAP benefits.
